info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Decision Retrieval API
info.description: The Loan Decision Retrieval API provides access to specific loan application decisions. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can retrieve detailed decision information related to a particular loan application, identified by its unique parameters. This API is typically used by financial institutions and loan processing systems to facilitate transparency and decision tracking for customers and internal auditors. The robust data enables users to understand decision criteria and outcomes effectively.

get.description: Fetches the decision associated with a specific loan application identified by the provided ID. This endpoint allows users to obtain detailed information about the decision made for a particular loan application.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the decision information regarding the loan application identified by RES-100045. It may include specific parameters for filtering or customizing the output related to the decision process.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the loan application decision.

GetLoanApplicationDecisionByIdRequest.description: This schema represents a request body for retrieving loan application decisions. It is expected to contain a JSON string.
